name: wipnote-orchestra
description: A powerline-style band under the prompt (usage limits and clock, repo, git, model, context, wipnote work items and tracks, subagents by work item with stalls and failures) and wipnote-ref work-item cards in replies.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the clock segment and the usage-limit reset times, such as America/New_York or Europe/London. An unknown zone falls back to America/New_York.

workItems.title: Work items
workItems.description: What the band shows of the work items: active (the active item and an "N in progress, M open" line, the default), list (up to the row cap below, plus that line), or off (no work-item block).

workItemRows.title: Work item rows
workItemRows.description: With Work items set to list, the most work items shown. At least 1.
